title: Form AOC-4 / AOC-4 XBRL: Annual Financial Statements Filing
summary: Mandatory filing of audited balance sheet, profit and loss account, and director report with the Registrar of Companies under Section 137 of Companies Act, 2013.

title: Form MGT-7 / MGT-7A: Annual Return of Company
summary: Mandatory statutory filing of company annual return disclosing shareholding pattern, directors, and indebtedness under Section 92 of Companies Act, 2013.
source_reference: Section 92, Companies Act 2013 & Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014

title: Form DIR-3 KYC / DIR-3 KYC-WEB: Annual Director KYC Verification
summary: Annual mandatory electronic verification of Director Identification Number (DIN) details for every approved DIN holder under Rule 12A.
source_reference: Rule 12A, Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014

title: Form PAS-6: Half-Yearly Dematerialisation Share Capital Reconciliation
summary: Reconciliation of share capital audit report for private non-small companies mandatorily dematerialising securities under Rule 9B.
source_reference: Rule 9B, Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Second Amendment Rules, 2023

title: RBI FLA Return: Foreign Liabilities and Assets Annual Reporting
summary: Mandatory annual reporting on FLAIR portal for Indian companies and LLPs having received Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) or made overseas investments.
source_reference: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 37 & Master Direction on Foreign Investment in India

title: RBI Form FC-GPR: Foreign Currency-Gross Provisional Return on Allotment
summary: Statutory reporting of non-resident share allotment within 30 days of equity issue under FEMA Foreign Exchange Management Regulations.

title: ITR-6: Corporate Income Tax Return for Non-TP Entities
summary: Annual electronic filing of income tax return under Section 139(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 for corporate entities subject to statutory tax audit.

title: Tax Audit Report Form 3CA/3CB and Form 3CD
summary: Mandatory filing of tax audit report by a practicing Chartered Accountant under Section 44AB of the Income-tax Act, 1961.

title: Form GSTR-1: Monthly Statement of Outward Supplies
summary: Mandatory monthly filing disclosing all outward taxable, exempt, and export sales by regular GST registered taxpayers under Section 37.
authority: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC
source_reference: Section 37, Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

title: Form GSTR-3B: Monthly Summary Return and Tax Payment
summary: Monthly self-assessed return summary for payment of output GST liability and discharge of net tax payable under Section 39.
authority: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC
source_reference: Section 39, Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

title: EPFO Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) Monthly Remittance
summary: Monthly remittance of 12% employee and employer provident fund contributions for establishments with 20 or more covered employees.
source_reference: Section 6, Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952

title: POSH Act: Annual Internal Committee Compliance Filing
summary: Mandatory annual compliance filing with the District Officer on complaints received, disposed, and workshops held under POSH Act 2013.
authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
source_reference: Section 21, Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013

title: Maharashtra Professional Tax (PTEC / PTRC) Monthly Return
summary: Statutory return and tax remittance for enrolled entities (PTEC ₹2,500/year) and registered employers (PTRC monthly deduction) in Maharashtra.
authority: Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Department (MahaGST)
regulatory_domain: State Revenue, Stamp Duty & Professional Tax
source_reference: Section 5, Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975

title: Karnataka Professional Tax (PT) Monthly Statement Form 5A
summary: Monthly return and payment of professional tax deducted from salaries of employees in Karnataka under Section 5.
authority: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka
regulatory_domain: State Revenue, Stamp Duty & Professional Tax
source_reference: Section 5, Karnataka Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1976

title: Delhi NCT Professional Tax Exemption Clarification
summary: Confirmation that the National Capital Territory of Delhi has no statutory enactment for Professional Tax; business entities in Delhi have zero PT registration liability.
authority: Department of Trade and Taxes, GNCTD
regulatory_domain: State Revenue, Stamp Duty & Professional Tax
source_reference: Constitution of India Article 276 & GNCTD Administrative Position

title: CERT-In 6-Hour Mandatory Cybersecurity Incident Notification
summary: Mandatory reporting of 20 categories of cybersecurity incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing or being brought to notice.
regulatory_domain: Data Privacy, Cyber Security & Digital Regulations
source_reference: Directions under Subsection (6) of Section 70B of Information Technology Act, 2000
